composition_policy: branch-preserving merge of independently frozen artifacts; no refit

contract.backend_state_feature: exact_unpadded_capacity if logical and physical boundaries are identical; GB200 head-dim-256 CP1 padded inputs then dispatch by the TE 2.14.1 masked-softmax kernel predicate

gb200_cp1_unavailable.reason: TE unfused 16K backward OOM on GB200

contract.gb200_d128_cp1_supported_domain_basis: analytical bounds from positive sequence lengths, 128-token per-sequence alignment, and physical storage capacity
contract.gb200_d256_cp1_supported_domain_basis: analytical bounds from minimum sequence length 256, 128-token per-sequence alignment, and physical storage capacity

gb200_multi_cp_unavailable.reason: TE 2.14.1 padded THD P2P backend limitation

gb200_d128_v2_edge_calibration.repeat_policy: one allocation for CP1-8; two for CP16-64

gb200_d256_cp1_runnable_calibration.memory_domain_policy: For each profile/storage, retain successful probes no larger than the smallest observed OOM dense work.

gb200_d256_cp1_softmax_repeats.selection_policy: For identical packs, retain the minimum stable wall_p10_ms across independent Slurm allocations.
